headline: Dewy to Fragrancier
title: Fragrancier | How Dewy Evolves | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Dewy evolves straight into Fragrancier at level twenty seven. Fragrancier is a stage three Dark Aniimo with one hundred and eleven attack and one hundred and ten regen. It resists Earth, but Light and Wind hit it for one point six times damage. In the wild it harvests nectar for perfume. Do you raise a Fragrancier? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Fragrancier evolution: Dewy evolves into the Dark Aniimo Fragrancier at level 27. Attack 111, regen 110. Weak to Light and Wind (1.6x), resists Earth. Checked on aniimo.gg and the Dexerto Aniimo wiki in November 2026.
joke: Fragrancier is so picky about smells that your Homeland should open a window.
